not_judged.AXIL-NO-PROT: The reference testbench (evals/flow/axi4_lite/axi4_lite_regs_tb.v) connects the ports by name (lines 58 to 65), and Icarus Verilog builds an instance that leaves a port of the block unconnected, so a block with a protection input such as s_axil_awprot passes it.
not_judged.AXIL-PARAMS-DEFAULT: The reference testbench (evals/flow/axi4_lite/axi4_lite_regs_tb.v) sets both parameters, ADDR_WIDTH to 4 and DATA_WIDTH to 32 (line 58), so the defaults are never used; a block whose ADDR_WIDTH defaults to 5 or whose DATA_WIDTH defaults to 64 passes it. Setting a parameter the block does not have fails to build, so the parameters themselves are judged (AXIL-PARAMS).
not_judged.AXIL-SYNTH: Synthesis is the RTL stage's own before-review check, not a held-out check.
not_judged.AXIL-FORMAL: The handshake proof is the RTL stage's own work; as for the timer (decision 2), the case proofs run on case files only and are not part of the whole-flow verdict.
